media.caption: The report names these two people and identifies dancing costume. It does not give an exact exposure date or establish every Arctic person’s everyday clothing. The complete printed plate is retained; an old expedition caption is evidence to read alongside community knowledge.
notice: Compare the shapes and contrasting bands of the two outfits.
What could a still photograph leave out about making and wearing them?
